title: Layangan Tujuh Belas
subject: a kampung kite maker who builds a three-metre kite for the Seventeenth of August contest and the whole street takes turns holding the line in the rice field
caption: Indonesian orchestral folk-pop waltz in the manner of Sal Priadi, poetic and theatrical. A fingerpicked nylon-string guitar and an upright piano carrying a 3/4 lilt; a string quartet answering each line and swelling into the choruses; a clarinet counter-melody; soft brushed drums keeping the waltz. Warm, close and acoustic, gentle room reverb, strings rising in the final chorus. Male baritone crooner, intimate and conversational, opening up on the last chorus. 84 BPM, G major. Tender, nervous and quietly proud. No trap beat, no autotune, no power-ballad drums, no EDM pads, no dangdut.
lyrics:
[Intro - strings in 3/4, acoustic guitar]

[Verse 1]
Seminggu Pak Darto di teras rumah
Bambu diserut, kertas minyak merah putih
Anak-anak duduk, nggak ada yang ngomong
Takut lemnya belum kering

[Pre-Chorus]
Tiga meter, katanya
Paling gede sekecamatan

[Chorus]
Naik, naik, layangan tujuh belas
Di atas sawah, angin lagi pas
Benangnya kita pegang bergantian
Satu gang narik pelan-pelan

[Verse 2]
Pagi itu angin sempat hilang
Layangan nyangkut di pohon kelapa
Bu RT teriak, panjat, panjat
Pak Darto cuma senyum sabar

[Pre-Chorus]
Jam dua belas angin datang
Semua orang lari ke pematang

[Chorus]
Naik, naik, layangan tujuh belas
Merah putih, tinggi dan bebas
Juara dua juga nggak apa-apa
Satu gang pulang ketawa

[Outro - strings settle]
Tahun depan empat meter
Katanya
